portrait.text: We are Mathis, Samuel and Sven, helicopter pilots by passion. We want to share our love of flying with as many people as possible. We'd be delighted to welcome you on board soon!

location.title: Central location
location.text: Buttwil airfield sits on the Lindenberg between Lake Hallwil and Muri. It can be reached in about 35 minutes from Zurich or 30 minutes from Aarau, making it an excellent starting point for flights over Zurich or into central Switzerland.

tours.title: Tours for 2 passengers
tours.text: Choose from a range of scenic flight packages between {{shortest}} and {{longest}} minutes, or plan your very own personal flight route with us.

pricing.title: Attractive pricing
pricing.text: Since we offer the scenic flights privately, you only pay the helicopter charter costs. That means scenic flights are available from CHF {{cheapest}}.- per person.

uetliberg.title: Uetliberg
uetliberg.synopsis: This scenic flight is especially beautiful just before sunset. In the evening light, the city of Zurich reveals itself from a completely new perspective. This route has two variants, as overflight of the city may not always be possible depending on traffic at Zurich Airport.

rigi.title: Rigi
rigi.synopsis: This scenic flight through central Switzerland takes us first to Lake Zug, then past the Rigi to the Mythen peaks. Above Schwyz we turn and follow Lake Lucerne towards Lucerne. Via Lake Baldegg we then return to Buttwil.

contact-data.title: Contact details
contact-data.info: We use this information solely to contact you and to send you an invoice after the flight.

flight-data.title: Flight details
flight-data.info: After receiving your booking we will check availability. You will receive a booking confirmation from us once helicopter availability has been confirmed.

disclaimer.text: By clicking "Book" you are making a binding reservation. For operational reasons (e.g. weather or maintenance on the helicopters) it is possible that a flight cannot take place on the requested day or may have to be cut short. There is no entitlement to a flight being carried out. In any case, only the flight costs actually incurred will be charged.
disclaimer.accept-terms: I accept the above conditions for the booking request.
